tex.sizes: 1024x1024: rock (+n), rock macro RGBA on UV2 (+n), slab (+n), gravel (+n), turf (+n), foliage RGBA

contract_changes.M_falls_rock: adds T_falls_rock_macro (UV2, RGBA: RGB colour x2 with 0.5 = x1, A relief height 0.5 = 0, 1 unit = 0.3 m) and T_falls_rock_macro_n (GL normal in UV2 tangent space); albedo = T_falls_rock(UV0) x macro.rgb x 2, then the Col masks as before. UV0 is now projected per face (box), 4 m tile.
contract_changes.Col masks: same meaning (R moss, G wet, B streak, A lichen) but sampled only at the corners of the merged planar faces (coarse); lichen/streak/ledge-moss detail now lives in the macro map.
contract_changes.rock kit: inst__falls_rock_k (k 0..6) now uses M_falls_slab (no UV2); no blocks stuck on the cliff any more (bank boulders, shallows, talus only).
contract_changes.plants: veg__falls_plants (both tiers) + veg__falls_plants_hi (high only), material M_leaf_falls_plants (T_falls_foliage, alpha-cut MASK 0.5, double-sided, same rules as M_leaf_*). Custom per-vertex normals.
contract_changes.trees: new inst__falls_tree_k (k 0..5) instances, materials M_falls_bark (T_bark) + M_leaf_green (T_leaf_green, village atlas).
contract_changes.tiers: objects with extras.tier = "high" are dropped on the low tier (export_extras on); falls_rock_lod1/falls_flank_lod1 carry tier = "low".
contract_changes.shape: face_x_detailed: groove core (|z-channel| < 2.4) exactly face_x, 2.4..3.8 cut inward only; plunge zone below the ledge cut inward only; 0.5 m off the camera wall. W0 --check: 44/44 ok.
